title: Why Movie Popcorn Costs So Much
topic: Why movie theater popcorn is so expensive
mechanism: Studios take about half or more of every ticket, but concessions are not shared and the food is cheap, so popcorn carries the theater's profit.

beats.hook: You pay nine dollars for a bucket of popcorn
beats.story: Your friend smuggles candy in his jacket to beat the theater
beats.rise: He thinks the theater still got paid from his ticket
beats.twist: A man in a suit walks into the box office and takes half the cash: the studio
beats.mechanism: Cash drawer with a STUDIO/THEATER divider, 70% deal stamp, rent bills, snack drawer 100% THEATER, popcorn price tag COST 17c, two jars MONEY 20% / PROFIT 40%, coin scale KEEPS 4c
beats.ending: Next week someone new buys popcorn and the marquee lights stay on

seed.what: The man in the suit waiting by the box office with a briefcase
